prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, natural skin texture with pores, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: 司辛, a fictional 50-year-old, Si Nian's adoptive father and deputy head of a state-owned chemical plant. He is a respected local official.; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Man of 50 with a square face, heavy jaw and slightly sagging cheeks. He has thick brows, a creased forehead and a prominent nose. His short black hair is combed back neatly and greying at the temples. He is of average build with a slight paunch and stands about 172 cm. He wears black-rimmed square glasses and a steel wristwatch on his left wrist.. Wearing one outfit only: Mid-grey wool Zhongshan (Mao) suit: a buttoned four-pocket jacket and matching grey trousers. Underneath is a plain white shirt collar. He wears a black mourning armband on his left sleeve, polished black leather shoes, black-rimmed glasses and a steel watch.. Signature colour: grey. Expression in the close-up shows: Pompous and image-conscious, easily rattled and superstitious. He dotes on his newly found biological daughter and is cold toward the adopted one. He blusters when challenged..
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 50, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
